entries.prompt: Edit the FIRST supplied photographic scene; the SECOND supplied image is an official Danish reference page, not a new scene. Each board faces the approaching car (the other side may be grey backing; in real life double-faced signs), with appropriate perspective for this photograph. Natural realistic original scene with only these missing official crossing boards added. Preserve the car's proximity to crossing, adult outside passenger door, no designated bay and no special permission. One E17 near each curb before the near zebra edge. Do not invent a parking bay, distance markings or legal exemption.
